title: Extension Cords
about: Learning the value of unseen backstage work while making extension cords during rehearsals.
description: This track focuses on one of the quieter jobs behind the show: building extension cords while performers rehearsed nearby. The work was repetitive, technical, and mostly invisible, yet every finished cable helped keep the production running. It's about learning that some of the most important contributions happen away from the spotlight, where nobody applauds, but everything still depends on the work being done right.

Lyrics: We sat off to the side of them
Cut the cable, strip the wire,
Fit the ends and test them right.
Simple work that kept us busy
While they built the show in light.
Trying not to wire it wrong.
One by one the others vanished,
Till I was the last one working on.
With the performers on the floor.
The voice coach finally told him
Maybe it cut deeper than it seemed.
Trying not to wire it wrong.
One by one the others vanished,
Till I was the last one working on.
Until you made a bad mistake.
Every plug had to be tightened,
Every line had to be safe.
There was no applause for finishing,
Trying not to wire it wrong.
One by one the others vanished,
Till I was the last one working on.
Some people build the quiet things
That keep the whole show alive.
But nothing on the stage can shine
Beside the practice and the noise.
Till the coach shut down his voice.
I learned that unseen work still matters,
Even when no one knows your name.
